name: Strakonice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly into a red upper fly part bearing a white Maltese cross and a yellow lower hoist part bearing a blue arrowhead with red shaft and white fletching.
history: Czech municipal flags are granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
